en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad

Well, don't get *too* used to it, Shuichi.
We aren't staying here forever.

When we get out of here, we're going to
travel the world to find my family.
Yeah, I know what you mean.

This place...isn't our future.
We don't belong here.

Let's get out of this place.
No matter what.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
